run_cmlm_translation: run the CMLM model to translate pre-processed data with a trained fairseq model
generate_batched_translations: generate batched translations by iterating over a dataset and yielding individual hypothesis predictions
generate_hypotheses_with_length_beam: generate hypotheses using a length beam search strategy with predicted target lengths
predict_length_beam: predict the length beam for target sequences using gold lengths or model-predicted lengths
dehyphenate_sentence: dehyphenate a sentence by replacing hyphens with the @ symbol for post-processing
